name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.InstCtx.pairs_tests
typeText:
∀ {k : Nat} {g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance} {m : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem},
  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.InstCtx k g m →
    Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.pairsAt m (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.TESTS))
      (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.tests (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g))

source.code:
theorem InstCtx.pairs_tests {k : ℕ} {g : GInstance} {m : Mem} (hm : InstCtx k g m) :
    pairsAt m (m TESTS) = g.base.tests := by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := hm.arr_tests
  unfold pairsAt
  apply List.ext_getElem (by rw [List.length_map]; exact h3)
  intro i hi hi'
  rw [List.getElem_map, arrAt_getElem]
  obtain ⟨_, _, g3, g4⟩ := h4 i hi'
  rw [g3, g4]

lines.text: obtain ⟨_, _, g3, g4⟩ := h4 i hi'
